---
title: "Time_series"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 10
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-align: center
library(leaflet)

# Read in your site metadata
sites <- read.csv("data/sites_metadata.csv")
circles = data.frame(lng = sites$Longitude, lat = sites$Latitude,
                     values = sites$Habitat)
pal <- colorFactor("viridis", levels = circles$values)

leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("Esri.WorldImagery") %>%  # Satellite imagery
  setView(lng = -149.84, lat = -17.5392, zoom = 11) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = circles, color = ~pal(values), 
                   radius = 3, opacity = 1, fillOpacity = 0.8) %>%
  addLegend(data = circles,
            position = "bottomright",
            pal = pal, values = ~values,
            title = "Legend",
            opacity = 1)

```
